text: A small pack of three new object types, shown as a gallery. An armchair: a seat, a backrest, two armrests and four short legs; its width can be set. A round coffee table: a round top on a central column with a round foot; the diameter and the height can be set, and the top can be clicked. A wall clock: a round face that hangs on the wall with an hour hand and a minute hand; the minute hand turns slowly; the diameter can be set. The scene is a showroom of the three.
